extracted.name: Russian Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Creamy and tangy, this classic Russian salad dressing melds tomato ketchup and smooth mayonnaise with a little vinegar for kick.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, ketchup, vinegar, onion, salt and pepper until thoroughly combined. Refrigerate until ready to use.
